supportFaq1Q: How do I upgrade my plan?
supportFaq1A: You can upgrade your plan at any time from the Billing settings in your dashboard.
supportFaq2Q: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
supportFaq2A: Yes, you can cancel from the Billing settings at any time. The Terms of Service explain what happens to fees.
supportFaq3A: Fees are non-refundable except where required by law. See the Terms of Service for details.
supportFaq4A: CodeSpectra runs in current versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Edge. Proctored assessments also need a webcam.
supportFaq5A: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest. The Security page explains how accounts and assessment data are protected.
supportFaq6Q: How long is my data kept?
supportFaq6A: Retention periods for each kind of data are listed in the Privacy Policy. For anything specific to your organization, contact us.
supportFaq7Q: Can I use CodeSpectra for personal projects?
supportFaq7A: Yes. Candidates can practise for free, and the Pricing page lists the paid plans.
supportFaq8Q: How many team members can I invite?
supportFaq8A: It depends on your plan. The Pricing page shows the current limits for each one.
